description.en:
Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renée. After engaging in a contract marriage with Alexander, Renée faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renée’s failing marriage?
___
Renée’s first love from childhood, Alexandre Chambler. Upon hearing the news that he had lost his mother, she rushed to his side— only to be met with a cold rejection and the heartbreak of her first love. Then one day, that very first love proposed to Renée. Thus began their contract marriage. Throughout the marriage, he had been indifferent— but 48 days before the divorce, he suddenly began to change? Will Renée and Alexandre’s contract marriage come to a smooth end?
description.es: La soledad puede tomar la forma del amor, ofreciendo al mismo tiempo consuelo y encarcelamiento. Un joven enfrenta el profundo dolor de la pérdida de su madre, mientras revive el intenso deseo por un primer amor que, aunque breve, deja una impronta en su vida. Con la memoria de Alexander Chambler presente en su corazón y el sufrimiento del rechazo resonando en su mente, su amor resurgen a través de un matrimonio impuesto por intereses y acuerdos. De esta manera, inicia un viaje lleno de reminiscencias del pasado y nuevas expectativas.
description.id: Cinta pertama Rene saat ia masih kanak-kanak adalah Alexander Chambler, yang kini menjabat sebagai direktur perusahaan otomotif dan merupakan pria paling terkenal di Kaliba. Untuk menghindari perhatian ratu yang ingin menjadikannya suami, Alexander datang mencari Rene dan mengajaknya menikah. Di luar, mereka pura-pura mesra, namun hubungan Rene dengan cinta pertamanya tidak terjalin dengan baik. Di penghujung pernikahan kontraknya, Rene diberikan kalung oleh nenek Alexander yang konon bisa mengabulkan permintaan pemiliknya. Meski tak terlalu percaya dengan kekuatan kalungnya, Rene berharap agar Alexander bisa bahagia, dan tak lama setelah itu, sikap Alexander yang tadinya dingin dan menyebalkan berubah total! Apa alasan di balik perubahan sifatnya itu?
description.ko:
어린 시절 '르네'의 첫사랑 '알렉산드르 챔블러'. 
그가 어머니를 잃었다는 소식에 한 걸음에 달려갔지만, 
돌아온 건 싸늘한 거절과 첫사랑의 좌절이었다. 

그러던 어느 날, 르네에게 그 첫사랑이 청혼해왔다. 
그렇게 시작된 계약 결혼 생활. 
결혼 생활 내내 무관심하던 그 남자가 이혼을 48일 앞둔 그날부터 갑자기 달라졌다? 

르네와 알렉산드르의 계약 결혼은 무사히 종료될 수 있을까?
description.ru: Контрактный брак — дело прагматичное. Особенно если у тебя нет выбора, а в «мужьях» — холодный, но слишком знакомый мужчина. Спустя два года Рене решила: хватит. Она хочет новой жизни, приключений и настоящей страсти… Но её «бывший» внезапно начал вести себя так, будто всё только начинается.
description.th: อเล็กซานเดอร์ แชมเบลอร์ คือรักแรกในวัยเด็กของเรเน่ เมื่อเธอได้ยินข่าวการจากไปของคุณแม่ของเขา เธอก็รีบไปหาเขาในทันที แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับกลับมา คือการปฏิเสธอย่างเย็นชาและความผิดหวังจากรักแรก กระทั่งวันหนึ่ง... อยู่ดี ๆ อเล็กซานเดอร์กลับมาขอเธอแต่งงาน?! และชีวิตการแต่งงานด้วยพันธสัญญาของเธอและเขาก็เริ่มต้นขึ้น ชายผู้ไม่เคยมีท่าทีสนใจเธอเลยตลอดชีวิตแต่งงาน กลับเริ่มเปลี่ยนไปในวันที่เหลือเวลาอีก 48 วันก่อนหย่า…? การแต่งงานของอเล็กซานเดอร์และเรเน่จะจบลงอย่างราบรื่นได้ไหมนะ?

description.en:
On the night of her fourth wedding anniversary, moans were heard from her husband’s bedroom. 

“Tell me I’m better than her, come on.”

It was the voice of her twin sister.
___
Infidelity comes with a price.

On the night of our fourth wedding anniversary, I witnessed my husband having an affair.

"I love you," he told my twin sister as he laid on top of her.

This can't just end easily with a divorce. No, I'll make them pay for this.
description.es:
"Su aroma está grabado en tu piel".
"En la noche de nuestro cuarto aniversario de bodas, descubrí que mi esposo tenía una aventura. 'Te amo', le dijo a mi hermana gemela tumbado encima de ella. El divorcio no será suficiente... ¡Haré que paguen por lo que hicieron!"
description.fr:
Je peux la sentir sur tes lèvres.
 La nuit de nos quatre ans de mariage, j'ai vu mon mari avec une autre femme. « Je t'aime », a-t-il dit dans les bras de ma sœur jumelle. Divorcer ? Trop facile. Ce que je veux, c'est me venger.
description.ko:
네 번째 결혼기념일 밤, 남편의 침실에서 대화 소리가 들려왔다.

“내가 그 여자보다 낫다고 말해줘, 어서.”

내 쌍둥이 여동생의 목소리였다.
description.ru:
На четвертую годовщину свадьбы Рианна узнала, что ее муж и сестра-близнец закрутили роман.
После длительного молчания она убрала ладонь с бледного лица. Во взгляде горел гнев.
"Итак, что же делать с этой ситуацией?"
Самым простым решением был развод. На сегодняшний день все теплые чувства к мужу окончательно улетучились, и она даже не хотела вспоминать, как сильно любила его в прошлом.
Все что осталось - это ненависть и...
"Я не могу просто смириться и отпустить это..."
Рианна желала мести.
description.th: ในค่ำคืนงานฉลองครบรอบแต่งงาน รีอันนาได้พบว่าสามีแอบเป็นชู้กับน้องสาวของตัวเอง นางโกรธแค้นมากที่ถูกทั้งคู่หักหลัง แต่นางจะไม่ยอมหย่าง่าย ๆ ต้องแก้แค้นพวกทรยศให้สาสมก่อน
description.zh: 在四周年结婚纪念日的晚上，丈夫的卧室传来了双胞胎妹妹的声音…“ 你快对我说，我比那个女人强。”我的婚姻居然是一场致命的骗局？废物丈夫和狡猾妹妹，在没尝到我的复仇前，就三个人一起生活下去吧。
description.es-la: La noche de nuestro cuarto aniversario de bodas, se escucharon gemidos en la habitación de mi esposo. "Dime que soy mejor que ella, vamos." Era la voz de mi hermana gemela.

description.en:
I was reincarnated as a supporting villain character. A trashy princess who was obsessed with the big brother of the cute heroine and eventually poisoned the heroine to destroy her. I made up my mind and prepared to run away. After saving the heroine, things went wrong.

"Those who touch her, chase them to the end of the world and destroy them."  
"Imperial family? The incompetent imperial family that makes Titania unhappy. They don’t matter anyway."  
"Hahahaha, they call me a mad dog. If a mad dog bites people, is it crazy?"

Gee, calm down everyone.  
Because I’m leaving to enjoy my dreams, hopes, and money in a seaside villa with beautiful waves! Everyone should be happy too! I thought so…

"…I thought you were really dead. I…"  
His golden eyes that contained me were engulfed in emotions I couldn’t read. I felt like I was going to drown just by looking at it.  
"…It felt like an endless nightmare, Tia."  
"Please don’t disappear in front of me like that anymore," while whispering earnestly.  
I was at a loss for words to say to him, who grabbed my hand as if tying me to go nowhere.

And…  
"It’s okay to hate my brother! But, don’t hate the duke’s money!"  
…The cute heroine who gives me the key to the underground safe containing all the treasures…  
"Is everything bothering you? Then choose me instead. Don’t let it bother yourself, Duchess. I’ll be by your side anytime, anywhere."  
Even the second older brother of the female protagonist, who always looked at me like a thorn in his eyes, became a bit strange. What is wrong here?
description.fr:
Je me suis réincarnée en méchante secondaire. En tant que princesse sans cœur, obsédée par le grand frère de l’adorable héroïne, qui a fini par empoisonner l’héroïne et connaître la ruine. J’avais pris ma décision et je m'étais préparée à m’enfuir. Mais après avoir sauvé l’héroïne, tout a commencé à dérailler.

« Ceux qui s’en prennent à ma sœur, je les poursuivrai jusqu’au bout du monde pour les anéantir. »
« La famille impériale ? Cette famille impériale incompétente qui rend Titania malheureuse. De toute façon, elle n'a aucune importance. »
« Hahahaha, ils me traitent de chien enragé ? Si un chien enragé mord les gens, est-ce qu'il est fou ? »
Calmez-vous, tout le monde. Je pars profiter de mes rêves, de mes espoirs et de mon argent dans une villa en bord de mer avec de magnifiques vagues ! Tout le monde devrait être heureux aussi !
…C’est ce que je pensais.
« …Je pensais que tu étais vraiment morte, je… »
Ses yeux dorés, qui me retenaient prisonnière, étaient submergés d’émotions que je ne parvenais pas à déchiffrer. J’avais l’impression de me noyer rien qu’en les regardant.
« …C'était comme un cauchemar sans fin, Tia. »
« Ne disparais plus jamais ainsi devant moi », murmura-t-il avec ferveur.
Je ne savais pas quoi lui dire, lui qui m’avait saisi la main comme pour m’empêcher de partir.

Et puis.
« Tu as le droit de détester mon frère. Tu as le droit de trouver mon père ennuyeux ! Mais, ne déteste pas l’argent de notre famille ducale ! »
…L’adorable héroïne qui me donne la clé du coffre-fort souterrain renfermant tous les trésors… 
« Tout ça t’ennuie ? Alors choisis-moi à la place de mon frère. Ne t’embête pas à jouer les duchesses. Je serai à tes côtés, à tout moment, où que ce soit. » 
Même le deuxième frère de l’héroïne, qui m’avait toujours regardé comme lune épine dans le pied, est devenu un peu bizarre. Que se passe-t-il ici ?
description.ko:
육아물 악역 조연으로 환생했다.
귀여운 여주인공의 큰오빠에게 집착하고 매달리다
결국 여주인공에게 독을 먹이고 파멸하는 그런 찌끄레기 황녀로.

너네는 이제 내 쪽에서 사절이야! 그렇게 다짐하고 튈 준비를 했는데.
여주인공을 구해 버린 뒤 일이 제대로 틀어져 버렸다. 

"언니를 건드리는 놈들, 세상 끝까지 쫓아가서 박살내버려."
"황실? 티타니아를 불행하게 만드는 무능력한 황실. 어찌 되든 무슨 상관인가."
"하하하하, 저 놈들은 날 미친개라 부르면서 왜 저리 머릿속이 비었대. 미친개가 사람 가려 물면 미친개인가?"

지, 진정하세요, 여러분. 
전 파도가 아름다운 바닷가 별장에서 꿈과 희망과 돈을 즐기러 떠날 거라서요!
여러분도 행복하세요!

...인 줄 알았는데.

“…당신이. 정말로, 죽은 줄 알고, 저는…….”

나를 담은 그의 금안이 내가 읽을 수 없는 감정에 잠겨 넘실거렸다. 
보는 것 만으로 익사할 것 같았다.

“…끝없는 악몽을 꾸는 기분이었습니다, 티아.”

더는 제 앞에서 그렇게 사라지지 말아주세요, 간절하게 속삭이면서도.
어디로든 가지 못하게 옭아매듯 내 손을 움켜쥐는 그에게 나는 할 말을 잃었다.

거기다.

“우리 오빠를 미워해도 좋아. 우리 아빠를 귀찮아해도 좋아! 그치만, 우리 공작가의 돈은 싫어하지 말아줘!”

…공작가 보물이 다 들어있는 지하금고 열쇠를 대뜸 쥐어주는 귀염뽀짝한 여주인공님이며.

“다 귀찮아? 그럼 형 대신 날 선택해. 귀찮게 공작 부인 같은거 하지 말고. 언제 어디서든 네 곁에 있을 테니까. 뭐? 개 같은 소리 하지 말라고? 왈왈으르렁컹컹!”

언제나 눈엣가시처럼 날 보던 여주인공 둘째 오빠까지 좀 이상해졌다. 너네 왜 이래?
description.ru:
Я переродилась в романе о воспитании ребёнка... и не кем-нибудь, а второстепенной злодейкой.

Той самой жалкой императорской принцессой, которая безнадёжно преследовала старшего брата главной героини, а в итоге отравила саму героиню и погибла самым жалким образом.

«Спасибо, но в этой истории я участвовать не собираюсь!»

Я уже была готова сбежать подальше от всех проблем и зажить спокойной жизнью. Но по пути случайно спасла главную героиню...

И всё пошло совершенно не по сюжету.

— Тех, кто посмеет обидеть сестрёнку, я найду хоть на краю света и уничтожу.

— Императорская семья? Сборище бесполезных людей, которые сделали Титанию несчастной. Какая мне разница, что с ними будет?

— Ха-ха... Забавно. Они называют меня бешеным псом, но сами настолько глупы. Если бешеный пёс выбирает, кого кусать, разве он всё ещё бешеный?

П-пожалуйста, успокойтесь!

Я всего лишь хочу уехать на красивое морское побережье, наслаждаться жизнью, мечтами и деньгами!

Живите счастливо и без меня!

По крайней мере, таков был план.

— Я... действительно думал, что ты умерла...

Его золотые глаза смотрели на меня с чувствами, которые я не могла понять. В них хотелось утонуть.

— Это было похоже на бесконечный кошмар, Тия.

Шепча просьбу больше никогда не исчезать, он крепко сжал мою руку, словно боялся отпустить хоть на мгновение.

Но это было ещё не всё.

— Можешь ненавидеть моего брата! Можешь считать моего отца занудой! Но только не отказывайся от денег нашего герцогского дома!

Главная героиня внезапно вручила мне ключ от сокровищницы, где хранились богатства всего герцогства.

А затем отличился и её второй брат, который раньше терпеть меня не мог.

— Всё надоело? Тогда выбери меня вместо брата. Не становись герцогиней. Я всегда буду рядом. Что? Перестать нести чушь?

Подождите.

Почему вы все вдруг стали такими странными?!

description.en:
I possessed an errand child who brought meals to the male protagonist who was captured as a test subject at the lab. If the experiment was successful and the male protagonist gained power, the lab would be engulfed in flames. So I tried to run away before that, but I felt bad for the male protagonist who was suffering from the cruel experiment. So I secretly took care of various things while avoiding the researchers' eyes.

"Come to think of it, what's your name?"

"I don't have a name..."

"You make me one."

"Huh?"

I somehow became a little close to the male protagonist.

"Are you going to abandon me? Don't do that."

"Ah... but-"

"Anis, do you mind if I'm wrong?"

"Ugh... No. No, I don't."

"Then stay by my side."

However, the only one who can cure him who is suffering from the side effects of the experiment is the original female protagonist.

I tried to help him and leave secretly so that he could find his partner...

"You promised not to abandon me. But, was it all a lie?”

With the burning laboratory in the background, Emilien smiled with cold eyes.

“A good child should keep his promises.”

The temperature of the hand touching my cheek is cold. The red eyes close as if they are going to engulf me.

“Answer, aren’t you going to tell me?”

...What should I do?

I think I missed my chance to run away.
description.ko:
[집착다정남 X  능력다정녀의 쌍방구원스토리] 

연구소에서 학대 받는 남주를 안쓰럽게 여기고 도와줬다가 그에게 집착당하게 됐다.

Она пожалела главного героя-мужчину, подвергавшегося насилию в лаборатории, и помогла ему, но в итоге сама влюбилась в него.

Если бы всё было по-настоящему, главная героиня вылечила бы главного героя-мужчину от побочных эффектов эксперимента...

description.en:
On the day I was promised in marriage to a prince, I witnessed my father and the Empress tangled together in a disgraceful affair. For my mother’s sake, I tried to endure it and pretend I hadn’t seen anything.

But when my mother learned the truth, she took her own life - leaving me with nothing but revenge. To deal with mad people, shouldn’t I become just as mad myself?

“Your Highness, the Crown Prince, will you marry me?”

The day before the wedding, I proposed to my fiancé’s half-brother - the Crown Prince - so that I could take revenge on my father and the Empress.
description.ko:
황자와 결혼을 약속한 날, 아버지와 황후의 뒤엉킨 꼴을 목격했다.
어머니를 생각해서 모른 척 참고 살아보려고도 했다.

description.en:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten?
___
I squandered my salary to strengthen my game character, and became the lowest-ranking extra in the game. But… [◆Fate: On my 9th birthday, I will be horribly murdered by my father.] No, what is my fate?! It was unfair that I dimensionally shifted while playing a game, but now I will die by my father’s hand… I can’t just sit back and accept this crappy fate. Since it has come to this, I will overcome my fate myself!
description.fr: On suit l'histoire d'une jeune femme réincarnée dans un roman où elle est une simple extra, fille unique d'un duc puissant. Consciente de son rôle secondaire, elle décide de changer sa destinée en influençant les événements du récit. À mesure qu'elle prend les choses en main, elle noue des relaitons stratégiques et cherche à éviter les tragédies prévues pour les personnages principaux. À travers cette quête, elle cherche à sortir de l'ombre et prendre son destin en main.
description.id: Aku menghabiskan gajiku untuk memperkuat karakter game, dan berakhir sebagai ekstra peringkat terendah dalam game. Tapi kemudian... [◆Takdir: Pada ulang tahun ke-9, akan dibunuh secara kejam oleh ayah sendiri.] Tungguh, apa ini takdirku?! Sudah tidak adil aku terjebak di dimensi lain saat bermain game, tapi dibunuh oleh ayahku sendiri...? Aku tidak bisa hanya menerima takdir menyedihkan ini. Karena sudah begini, aku akan mengatasi takdirku sendiri!

description.en:
Somehow, before the appearance of the female lead, I became the male lead’s temporary wife. Since things had already turned out this way, I decided to try my very best. However…  
  
“It’s so fortunate that someone like you became Cedric’s partner.”  
“…I’ll admit it. It’s a fortune that you were the one to become his wife, Dylan.”   
“It’s such a fortunate chance that you were the one to become the Lady of the Brighton House.”  
  
…I think I did too much of a good job.   
  
When Cedric’s destined partner arrives, I will have to leave. What should I do? To someone like that, Cedric had said this.   
  
“Would you have ever thought that the one I would fall in love with would be you?”  
  
…Would you still say the same to me after the real female lead, Adeline, makes her appearance?

---
The spunky Lady Dillon didn't realize she was the villain of a romance novel until she encounters Marquess Cedric. Seeing him jogs a dormant memory of the novel's plot, in which her beloved younger sister dies in childbirth after marrying Cedric. Determined to prevent this, Dillon marries him herself, but what fate awaits her when she knows he's meant to fall in love with the real female lead later? In this marriage of convenience, it seems nothing turns out quite how either of them expects...

The war surrounding the veil at the center of the world is over. However, the war was not the only thing the veil left in its wake. There are those who pursue the veil and those who seek to close it; those who wield special powers and those who are living weapons; those who disturb the peace and those who bring hope; those who collide with the paths they have walked and those who carry a coffin, seeking to resurrect the dead. Together, they are known as Actors.

Elio, a country count's daughter, gets caught up in her father's scheming plot to seduce a young duke.

Without even laying a finger on him, she overnight becomes a "trashy young lady" who allegedly assaulted the imperial princess's fiancé.

However, instead of setting the record straight, the young duke fans the flames of the scandal. To help Elio escape her abusive father, he proposes a deal: pretend to be his fiancée for three months.

Thus begins their fake engagement. The only problem is that she keeps getting shaken, as if it were all real.

description.en:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns.

That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party.

Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?
description.ja: 高難易度で悪名高いモバイルガチャゲームで、世界ランキング5位の凄腕プレイヤー、ロキがダンジョン攻略中に意識を失ってしまう。「え？俺がゲームのキャラに？」目覚めると、ロキはなんとレベル1、星1つのヒーロー、ハン・イスラットになっていた。元の世界に戻るため、彼は新米マスターとヒーローたちを率いて、ダンジョンの100階層をクリアしなければならない。「俺を怒らせたな」。決して敗北を認めないマスター、ロキによる、最強のキャリーが始まる！
description.pt-br:
No jogo de gacha mobile famoso por sua extrema dificuldade, o Mestre classificado em 5º lugar no mundo, "Loki" perde a consciência ao invadir a Masmorra.

"O quê? Eu sou um personagem de jogo agora?"

Depois de acordar, "Loki" percebe que ele se transformou em um Herói de Nível 1, 1 Estrela – 'Han Yslat'. Para retornar à Terra, ele deve liderar o Mestre e os heróis novatos e limpar o 100º andar da Masmorra!

"Você mexeu com o cara errado".

Esta é a história de transporte mais difícil  pelo Mestre Loki que nunca aceita uma única derrota.
description.zh-hk: 故事圍繞一款號稱有著無人能完整攻略的地下城，以地獄級難度著稱的抽卡手遊《Pick me up!》。而被稱為大師中的大師，排名全球第5的玩家「洛基」，在攻略地下城的過程中失去了意識，並在醒來後發現自己成了《Pick me up!》中的英雄——類別、等級皆為1級的「韓．伊斯拉特」。「這一定是那傢伙幹的。是那傢伙把我拖進來的！」為了重回地球，洛基必須要帶領新手大師和眾多英雄攻略100層的地下城！「你——惹錯人了。」這是來自大師洛基的強行助攻，且容不下半點失誤！

description.en:
Oh Kangwoo the Demon King has had it with ruling over Hell and wants to return to Earth. 

But when he finally gets there, not only are his powers sealed, but the Earth he once knew has turned into an MMORPG free-for-all. 

Dimensional gates have appeared all over the world, and "players" enter them to make a living by hunting monsters. If Kangwoo wants to survive in this dangerous game, he's going to have to level up, and fast. 

But for this demon king, hell on earth might be worse than Hell itself!
description.ko:
어느 날, 갑작스럽게 지옥으로 떨어졌다. 
가진 것은 살고 싶다는 갈망과 포식의 권능 뿐.
 
일천의 지옥부터 구천의 지옥까지. 수만, 수십만의 악마를 잡아먹었고. 
마침내 일곱 대공까지 그 앞에 무릎을 꿇었다.
 
"어째서 돌아가려고 하십니까? 
왕께서는 이미 지옥의 모든 것을 가지고 계시지 않습니까."

"가지긴 뭘 다 가져."

먹을 것도, 즐길 것도 없다! 
지옥에 있는 거라고는 황량한 대지와 끔찍한 악마 뿐! 

"난 돌아갈 거야." 

만 년이라는 아득한 시간 만에 그가 지구로 귀환한다.


그러나.. 지구는 자신이 그동안 알던 지구가 아니었다.
description.ru:
Внезапно оказавшись в Аду, всё, что у него осталось это вера и тяга к жизни. Он уничтожал тысячи демонов на всех кругах Преисподней. Даже семь верховных герцогов Ада пали после встречи с ним.

— Владыка, зачем вам обратно на землю? Вся Преисподняя в ваших руках!

— Заткнись и продолжай подготовку к обряду!

Ни вкусной пищи, ни привычных развлечений… лишь ужасающие демоны и безжизненные пустыни.

— Как же хочется вернуться обратно домой…

Спустя 10,000 лет Игрок возвращается на землю.
description.uk:
Раптом опинившись в Пеклі, все, що в нього залишилося це віра і потяг до життя. Він знищував тисячі демонів на всіх колах пекла. Навіть сім верховних герцогів Ада впали після зустрічі з ним.

— Владико, навіщо вам назад на землю? Все пекло у ваших руках!

— Заткнися і продовжуй підготовку до обряду!

Ні смачної їжі, ні звичних розваг… лише жахливі демони та неживі пустелі.

— Як же хочеться повернутися додому…

Через 10.000 років Гравець повертається на землю.
description.pt-br: Um dia, KangWoo de repente foi para o Inferno, apenas com seu forte desejo de sobreviver e com sua Autoridade de Predação. Em todo seu caminho do 1ºinferno até o 9º, ele devorou centenas de milhares de demônios, até que os Sete Arquiduques finalmente se ajoelhassem diante dele. “Por que deseja voltar? Você já não possuí tudo aqui no Inferno, meu lorde?” “O que tenho exatamente?” Não tinha nada para comer, nem sequer um entretenimento! Ilhas desoladas e demônios medonhos preenchiam todo o Inferno. “Vou voltar.” Depois de dez mil anos no 9ºInferno, ele retornou à Terra.

Was it an angel, demon, or some unknown system of the world? Because of his good deeds, he got a chance to live again.
But he was resurrected as a dead man who was killed by mountain bandits. But this body… Is it the body of a great legendary surgeon?!
A generation of heroes with an endless battle, about in the year 200. As a great legendary surgeon of the 200’s, he tries to stand up to it……
An unexpected and extraordinary journey of a young surgeon, who fell into the world of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, has began!

description.fr:
Était-ce un ange, un démon ou autre chose qui m'a ressuscité ?
Jisoo Han, un major de troisième année en chirurgie générale, a perdu la vie en raison de sa personnalité droite. Cependant, grâce aux bonnes actions qu'il a faites dans sa vie, il a été ressuscité dans le corps d'un homme mort qui a été tué par des bandits de montagne. Mais ce corps… Est-ce le corps d'un grand chirurgien légendaire ?! Maintenant, dans l'ère des Trois Royaumes de guerres et de héros [CE 200]. Jisoo essaie de survivre et de se tenir debout en tant que chirurgien légendaire ……
Le voyage inattendu et extraordinaire d'un jeune chirurgien, tombé dans l'ère des Trois Royaumes, a commencé !
description.ko:
정의로운 성격 때문에 전문의는 커녕, 목숨까지 잃은 일반외과 전공 3년차 한진수.

천사인가, 악마인가, 아님 알 수 없는 시스템인가.
평소 쌓은 선행 덕분에 부활의 기회를 얻게 된다.

산적 떼에게 죽은 몸으로 부활하게 된 한진수.
그런데 이 몸이 전설의 명의名醫 화타?!

전란이 끊임없는 영웅들의 시대, 혼란한 후한 말.
한진수, 그는 후한 말 명의名醫 화타로서 우뚝 서려 한다…….

<삼국지연의> 속 세상에 떨어진 젊은 외과의사가 펼치는

description.en:
Jin Yoosung was a gifted surgeon said to be able to bring the dead back to life. However, not even this genius doctor had the ability to revive himself. Following a fatal car crash, Yoosung closed his eyes for what he'd thought was the last time… only to wake up and find that he's been reborn in a fantasy world!

A doctor through and through, Yoosung — now Ray — resolves to become a healer again. Unfortunately, it seems his new magical abilities may not be the most fitting for his dream career…
description.ko:
천재 의사로 의학계에 이름을 떨치던 유성.
수술실을 집처럼 여기던 그는 어느 날 교통사고로 죽게 되고,
정신을 차려 보니 다른 세계로 떨어져 버렸다.

그런데.
성녀…성국…힐링 마법이라고?

"내가 얼마나 힘들게 의학을 배웠는데, 손만 대 놓고 치료 끝?
아, 나. 진짜 미쳐버리겠네."
description.pt-br:
Yusung é um médico genial e famoso no mundo da medicina. Sua vida é dedicada à sala de cirurgia, mas tudo muda quando ele morre em um acidente de trânsito e, ao acordar, se vê em um mundo completamente diferente. Nesse novo mundo, existe uma santa e um império sagrado, e a magia de cura é uma realidade. 
Para Yusung, que passou toda a sua vida estudando medicina, é difícil acreditar que agora tudo o que ele precisa fazer é tocar em alguém para curá-lo. É uma experiência surreal que o faz questionar sua sanidade.

description.en:
Joshua Sanders, the legendary spearman who ended the brutal civil war, shattered the belief that one must wield a sword to be a master knight.

He fought in the service of his friend, Emperor Caesar van Briton, but it is all for naught when his fearful comrades try to kill him. He’s on the brink of death when his trusty weapon, Lugia, shines and propels him back to the stables of his childhood.

With his mighty spear in hand, Joshua is dead set on revenge in this life!
description.es: El invicto caballero lanza. Una estrella brillante de una casa del Ducado que rompió por completo la lógica común de que un caballero debe usar una espada. El gran héroe que puso fin a la larga guerra civil del imperio. Su nombre era "Joshua Sanders". El hombre conocido como la Lanza Legendaria del Emperador tosía sangre. De las manos de nada menos que su señor, el emperador César... "César, ¡¡no creas que este será el final !!" Mirando a la muerte a la cara con un círculo mágico de explosión frente a él, la lanza "Lukia" que ha estado con él durante décadas comenzó a brillar... Este lugar familiar... ¿Es el establo en el que solía vivir cuando era niño? ¡Incluso me volví más joven! Lukia, ¿qué eres? ¡Joshua ha vuelto a su infancia! ¡Y ahora comienza la historia de su épica venganza!
description.it: Joshua Sanders, un maestro cavaliere che pose fine ad una brutale guerra civile, viene tradito e ridotto in fin di vita dai suoi compagni d'armi. In quelle condizioni brandisce Lukia, la sua fidata e potente lancia che, brillando come una stella nascente, lo riconduce alla sua infanzia. Cosa fareste se vi venisse concessa una seconda possibilità?
description.ko:
무패의 창기사.
기사는 검을 써야만 한다는 고정관념을 철저히 깨부순 
공작 가문의 빛나는 별. 제국의 오랜 내전을 일시에 종식시킨 대영웅. 
그 이름은 바로 '조슈아 샌더스'.

황제의 역대 최강의 창이라고도 불리는 그가 명성에 어울리지 않는     
검붉은 피를 울컥거리고 있었다. 다른 누구도 아닌 자신의 주군, 
카이사르 황제의 손에 의해...
"카이사르, 이렇게 끝날 거라 생각하지 마라!!"
폭발 마법진에 의해 죽음을 앞둔 그 순간, 수십 년을 함께 해온 창 
'루기아'가 엄청난 기운을 내뿜기 시작하는데...
낯이 익은 이곳은 설마... 어렸을 때 살던 마구간?
몸도 어려졌잖아?! 루기아 너 대체 정체가 뭐야?

다시 유년시절로 돌아온 조슈아! 그의 사이다 복수극이 시작된다!
description.ru:
Непревзойденный копейщик.

Стереотип о необходимости владения мечом разрушает ярчайшая звезда из герцогской семьи. Герой, что положил конец войне империи, и имя ему - Джошуа Сандерс.

Несмотря на его величие и репутацию, теперь он полумертвый истекает багрового цвета кровью. Ранен он не кем иным, как рукой собственного императора, - Кайзера...

"Кайзер!.. Не мечтай, что всё закончится так легко!!!".

Последние мгновения смерти сопроводили излияния огромного количества энергии от его соратника - копья, что носило имя "Ругия"...

Я... Помолодел?.. Ругия, что ты, черт возьми, такое?!

Джошуа вернул себе молодое тело, и его месть начнется с этого момента!

---
В империи Авалон, где рыцари славятся своим искусством владения мечом, одинокий герой прославился, как величайший лансер — мастер копья. Он остановил войну и рисковал жизнью ради друзей, но наградой за это стало лишь предательство. Благодаря своему магическому копью лансер получил второй шанс: он переместился в прошлое, сохранив все свои воспоминания из прошлой жизни. Знакомьтесь: девятилетний Джошуа Сандерс — величайший лансер всех времён!
description.pt-br: O cavaleiro de lança invicto. Uma estrela brilhante de uma família de Duques, que quebrou completamente a lógica comum de que um cavaleiro deve usar uma espada. O grande herói que pôs um fim à longa guerra civil do império. Seu nome era 'Joshua Sanders'. O homem conhecido como a Lendária Lança do Imperador estava tossindo sangue. Pelas mãos de ninguém menos que seu senhor, o Imperador César… “César, não pense que este será o fim!”! Olhando a morte no rosto com um círculo de explosão mágico à sua frente, a lança ‘Lugia’, que está com ele há décadas, começou a brilhar… Esse lugar familiar… É o estábulo onde eu costumava viver quando era criança? Eu até fiquei mais jovem! Lugia, o que você é? Joshua voltou à infância! E agora começa a história de sua vingança épica!

description.en: As the descendant of a legendary hero, Idnia Katze inherited a power that makes her as imposing as a workhorse. But when she's forced to enroll at a prestigious academy to avoid her own death, she realizes she should probably rein it in; otherwise, she might just steal the spotlight from the future saint and become an obstacle in her quest to save the world! ---
Princess Evienrose, despite advocating fiercely for the rights of the homunculi rebels, now awaits death at their hands… that is until she is poisoned by her own sister! Awakening eight years in the past, Eve now has one goal: become the Empress and liberate the homunculi to stop the rebellion from ever happening! To do this, she appoints the rebel king himself, Mikaelis Agnito, as her personal knight. But with Eve’s scheming sisters standing in the way, the fight for the crown is on, and the fate of the Hadelamid empire rests in her hands!

---
The seventh imperial princess, Evenrose, once died. Her last memory was of the royal family was destroyed by the Homunculus, the rebelling slaves, and of her sister who had sided with the rebels and urged her to escape her painful execution by swallowing poison. But when she opened her eyes again, "I...I'm not dead." She realizes that she had gone eight years back in time, back to a time before her cruel sister Bridgette was chosen as the next emperor. Given the opportunity to prevent the fall of the imperial family by being chosen as the next emperor herself, she decides to write her own article about Michael, the king of Homunculus and the monster of public prison, in order to win the emperor's heart. "I need you, Michael. Very badly." Will Evenrose be able to get him and protect the imperial family safely?

description.fr:
Il était une fois, un royaume où grâce à une alchimie interdite, des homonculus étaient créés.

Ces homonculus devaient se soumettre à la volonté de la famille Impériale à l’aide d’une magie d’asservissement. Les plus doués d’entre eux faisaient partie de la garde du château et parmi eux, la famille Impériale devait en choisir un pour en faire leur chevalier personnel. Mais un homonculus résista au sort de l’Empereur: Mikhaelis Agnito.

Il organisa une rébellion, souleva les homonculus contre l’empire et exécuta toute la famille Impériale à l’exception de la 7ᵉ princesse, Evenrose et la 8ᵉ princesse, Rosenite. Cette dernière, éperdument amoureuse de Mikhaelis, croyait qu’elle portait en elle le «résultat de leur amour.» Elle pensait être exceptionnelle mais elle n’était en vie qu’uniquement parce qu’elle avait subit une expérience avec la pierre philosophale, qui ne fonctionnait seulement qu’avec le sang royal. Une simple marionnette que Mikhaelis pouvait contrôler à sa guise.

Cependant, le traître avait des sentiments pour Evenrose, car elle était différente. Elle était contre l’utilisation des homonculus comme esclaves et étudia durement pour leur rendre leur liberté, faisant d’elle le mouton noir de la famille Impériale. Malheureusement, elle ne comprit pas les actions de Mikhaelis et croyait qu’elle allait se faire exécuter comme les siens.
Rosenite en profita pour venir la voir et l’empoisonner, se réjouissant de la mort de sa demi-sœur, pensant avoir Mikhaelis pour elle seule. En apprenant la nouvelle de la mort d’Evenrose, Mikhaelis tente alors par tous les moyens de la ressusciter. Un mage lui proposa un moyen: celui de retourner dans le temps. Néanmoins, seule Evenrose gardera les souvenirs de tout ce qui c’était passé jusqu’à présent. Mikhaelis accepta sans sourciller, du moment que sa bien aimée était en vie. Quand le sort se lança, Evenrose ouvrit les yeux et se retrouva 8 ans en arrière.

Sera-t-elle capable de changer son destin?

Но если бы он только знал, что его новая соседка станет врагом всей его жизни... Ведь Хейзел Мэйфилд мечтает о собственной ферме. Она обладает способностью "Рука Солнца", что позволяет ей оживить даже самый гиблый росток. - Чем это так воняет? - Пахнет навозом, Ваше Величество. "Как достать соседа" начинается!

description.en:
When I first came into the book, my goal was just to survive.

‘I have to live longer! And be happy!’ So I did my best.

I am going to walk on my own flower path.

“Wherever I go, the seat next to you is mine. You promised to pat my head for the rest of your life, isn’t that right?” The strongest male character, who was stabbed to death in the original novel, stared at me with obsessive eyes.

If I say no, he will destroy the world.

“Yes, I’ll kill him. Then you’ll be happy, too, right?” The fifth brother looked a bit crazy.

“This is my land from here to here. And yours, too. I’m glad to be able to breathe with your grandest dreams.” The fourth oldest sister, who became the richest woman on the continent, opened the map and said that.

If I say I don’t have such a grand dream like her, I think a catastrophe will happen.

“I’m looking forward to the Winter Solstice that you’ll rule completely.” Laughter rose on the face of the butler who served me.

“If you don’t connect to Verratoux, my heart will stop tomorrow morning. Are you sure you’re okay with that?” My first sister, who was supposed to be the original successor, threatened me with her life.

And this is the biggest problem. Somehow, a faint smile raised my father’s mouth, which became stronger than the original father he was. “Independence? Try it then. I won’t even let a single ant live on this land.”

“Did you think you could leave my arms and stand on your own…” He then stared at me obsessively.

They are all acting weird.

Everything went wrong.

I only did my very best.

But after dozing off somewhere midway through the novel “Birth of a Hero,” he wakes up as Cale Henituse - one of the minor villains in the novel who gets the beating of a lifetime from soon-to-be hero Choi Han.

Quindi ora lui vive il suo personaggio e gli eventi della storia per come se li ricorda. Ma cosa dovrà fare Cale Henituse una volta superato il punto dove Kim si era fermato?

Gdy otworzyłem oczy, znalazłem się w świecie z powieści „Narodziny bohatera”.

Książka ta opisuje przygody Choi Hana - licealisty, który przeniósł się z Ziemi do innego świata - oraz wielu innych bohaterów. Ja znalazłem się w ciele śmiecia z hrabskiej rodziny, na której to terytorium położona jest wioska, w której mieszka Choi Han.

Po tym, jak wioska zostaje zaatakowana przez tajemniczych napastników, główny bohater powiadamia o zdarzeniu syna hrabiego, lecz ten go zbywa.
Następnie ów syn zostaje zbity na kwaśne jabłko.

„To… dość problematyczne.”

description.uk:
Коли я відкрив очі, я опинився в новелі.

[Народження героя] - новела, присвячений пригодам головного героя Чхве Хана, хлопчика старшої школи, якого перенесли в інший вимір із Землі, і який народжений як один з численних героїв континенту .
Я став частиною цього роману як старший син графа, сім'я, якого контролювала територію, де знаходиться перше село, яке відвідує Чхве Хань.

Чхве Хан змінюєть після того села, а після — всі її мешканці буди вбиті таємною організацією.

Більшою проблемою є той факт, що цей нікчемний покидьок, яким я став, не знає про те, що трапилося в селі, і насміхається над Чхве Ханом, лише щоб його побили.

"... Це стане проблемою"

Я відчуваю, що зі мною станеться щось серйозне.

Але варто спробувати зробити своє нове життя кращим.

Ele havia sido transportado para o mundo da novel no corpo de Cale Henituse, o lixo da família do conde Henituse e um nobre mimado que tinha sido espancado pelo protagonista no começo da história. Neste novo mundo cheio de perigo e magia, Cale Henituse (Kim Rok-Soo) deseja apenas viver uma vida tranquila e livre de problemas, mas as coisas nem sempre vão de acordo com o planejado…

description.en:
Psyche Silkisia lived her whole life as a fill-in for the missing daughter of House Silkisia. Despite her attempts to be accepted by the family, they accuse her of murder and force Psyche to commit suicide. Devastated by this, Psyche swallows the poison she's given and miraculously finds herself in the past. Determined to live for her own sake this time, Psyche hurries to escape. But when her family suddenly refuses to let her go, she realizes that perhaps she isn't the only one who's changed...

---
I lived my whole life as a substitute for the lost princess. But the moment the real princess came back, “Let’s be thankful that it ends like this.”

I was sorrowfully abandoned. …No, the ending would have been the same even if the real princess had not returned.

“I think my usefulness is up to here, so I’ll leave now.”

“If you come back, I’ll acknowledge you as a real daughter.”

“I don’t need it.”

I wouldn’t be loved by anyone, but it didn’t matter. I decided to live my own life completely.

“It goes up high enough for everyone to look up to.”

“I’ll make it like that for you.”

“Don’t leave me. Do you get it?"

Whispering that he loves me, and even asking me if I knew it.
description.fr: Moi, Psyché Silkicia, j'ai lutté toute ma vie pour être acceptée. Adoptée par le duc à la disparition de sa fille, j'ai passé ma vie à jouer la remplaçante... Puis un jour, la vraie fille du duc a refait surface, et n'ayant plus besoin de moi, la fausse, ils m'ont poussée au suicide. Mais au lieu de mourir, j'ai été renvoyée dans le passé, au jour du retour de cette fille! Qu'à cela ne tienne, le duc a retrouvé sa fille? Eh bien moi, je vivrai enfin librement! Je ne serai plus un pâle reflet!
description.id: Walau terus disebut sebagai Putri Palsu, Psyche selalu berusaha keras demi mendapat pengakuan dari keluarganya, keluarga Duke Silkisia. Meski pada akhirnya... hidup Psyche harus berakhir saat dituduh membunuh Lillian, putri yang sesungguhnya. Di akhir hayatnya, Psyche berdoa, bilamana dia diberi kehidupan selanjutnya, dia akan hidup untuk dirinya sendiri, bukan untuk keluarga yang sedari awal tidak pernah menganggapnya.
description.ko:
**이제 내 모든 것을 되찾겠어.**

"내 자리는, 처음부터 없었구나…."

가짜 공녀라 손가락질 받으면서도 가족들의 인정을 받기 위해 헌신했지만,
모두에게 배신 당한 프시케는 진짜 공녀를 살해하려 했다는 누명을 쓴 채 죽음을 맞는다.

'내게 다음 생이 주어진다면, 절대로 이렇게 살지 않을 것이다.'

마지막 순간 떠올린 생각 덕이었을까.
프시케가 눈을 뜨자 진짜 공녀가 돌아오기 전 과거로 돌아가 있었다.

'당신들에게 휘둘렸던 모든 시간이 후회돼.'

다시 주어진 삶, 운명의 굴레에서 벗어나 가문이 아닌 나 자신을 위한 삶을 살겠다.
description.ru:
Всю жизнь я прожила заменой потерянной принцессе. Но как только она вернулась:
— Будьте благодарны за то, что все так завершилось.
Меня бросили.
...нет, финал был бы таким и в случае, если бы она не вернулась.
— Мне кажется, я сделала все, что можно было. Я ухожу.
— Если вернешься, я признаю тебя законной дочерью.
— Мне это не нужно.
Меня бы никто не любил, но это не имело значения. Я решила посвятить жизнь себе.
— Он возвысился достаточно высоко, чтобы все смотрели на него снизу вверх.
— Я сделаю для тебя все.
— Не оставляй меня. Ты поняла? — шептал он о любви.

description.en:
As the only hope to stop the end of the world, I’ve lived 99 lives with everyone pressuring me to sacrifice myself. I dearly hoped this life would be my last…!

“A lady is born!”

I’ve ended up beginning my 100th life. They’re going to give me a hero treatment and sacrifice me again anyways. Is what I thought, but—

“Thank you for being born safely.”
“Unnie’s gon to get dem all for you!”
“Can I please see our youngest smiling as well?”
“Hey little baby, did you miss me?”

This life is a bit… weird.

description.en:
Mia Evelan has never left the tiny room where her aunt and uncle keep her locked up. Then one night, she has a series of dreams that show her the future, and learns that her true father could be a demonic grand duke. Knowing this, Mia plans to escape her room and ask the grand duke for child support so she can strike out on her own. But once they've met, her father isn't intent on letting her go so easily! Should Mia choose a life of independence or one with her newly found demon family?

---
I'm Mia, a child abused by my family. One day I had a 'dream' and saw the future. A future where I fell for my aunt and uncle's schemes, accidentally murdered my older half-brother, and causing a great war. Things just can't end like this, so I'll change the future with my own hands! 

With the information gathered from the dream, the first thing I have to do is find my biological father!

"Gimme thild thupport!"

(If only I didn't lisp!) In return for selling information about my uncle's schemes and taking all the backlog of child support from my biological father, I was planning on leaving…

But then my eldest brother, who boasts an aloof beauty, said, "I'm thinking of building you an amusement park."

My reckless second eldest brother interrupted and said, "Shall I buy you a tropical island covered with pretty flowers?"

And the most handsome man in the world, my Papa, replied on a whole nother level! "I'll buy you an artifact which calls for mermaids."

No, no, no! All three have terrible liquidity! The cleverest, smartest, most materialistic, devilish answer is… "Please make me a slide made of pure gold!"
description.ko:
"양유삐 주세요!(양육비 주세요!)"

외숙부와 이모에게 학대를 받으며 살던 미아. 어느 날, 그녀는 꿈 속에서 자신이 외숙부의 계략에 넘어가 친오빠를 살해하고, 세계 멸망을 일으키는 미래를 보게 된다.

이렇게 죽을 수는 없지! 미래는 내 손으로 바꾼다!

미아는 친부에게 외숙부의 흉계를 팔아 넘기고, 밀린 양육비에 정보 비용을 얹어서 청구하기로 결심하는데...

나는 제법 심각한 표정을 지으며 입을 열었다. 양손도 자랑스레 펼쳐 보인 채였다.

"샤다 샤. 그삐 정보에 단됸 천 골드! (싸다 싸. 극비 정보에 단돈 천 골드!)"

저기, 세계 멸망을 막을 정보 사실래요?

_

"꽃이 예쁘게 피는 열대 섬 하나 사줄까?"
아벨이 이렇게 말하자마자,

"섬에 아무것도 없으면 심심할테니 큰 오빠가 놀이동산을 하나 지어줄까 해."
카이옌 오빠가 끼어들고,

"나는 인어를 부르는 아티팩트를 사주마. 그게 있으면 밤새 인어의 노래를 들으며 놀 수 있을 거다."
아빠는 한 술 더 뜬다!

나는 영리하고 똑똑한 속물 악마답게 공손히 입을 열었다.

"미끄럼틀은 순금으로 만들어 주세요."

Mia cresceu sendo abusada por seu tio e tia. Um dia, em um sonho, ela vê um futuro que cai no esquema de seu tio e tia maternos, mata seu meio-irmão e causa uma grande guerra. Em troca de vender as artimanhas do meu tio materno para o meu pai biológico, eu planejava sair com a pensão alimentícia e os custos de informação...
“Estou pensando em construir um parque de diversões.”

description.en:
Lilyca is a poor girl who used to spend every day with her alcoholic mother.

However, one day...

"Kyaa, it's hot! No!"

Her mother woke up screaming and nonsensically asked, "Lily, you're alive! Have you gotten younger?"

"What's the date?"

She'd lost her mind!

"This can't be... I've come back!"

She started spouting more puzzling things, even going so far as to say, "We need to go to the Imperial Ball and meet the Emperor!"

Lilyca began to worry that something had gone wrong with her Mother's head...

---
Lyrica is a hardworking 8-year-old girl who has always used her vivid imagination to escape the harsh realities of living in the slums with her neglectful mother. After her mother has a premonition of a disastrous future, she snaps to her senses and devises a plan to provide a different life for Lyrica. But even Lyrica couldn't have imagined that the plan was to marry the emperor! Now that she has everything she could ever dream of, can Lyrica face reality in spite of her wild imagination?

description.en:
Laviore Bailey — the ‘fake saintess’ who banished the innocent princess and stirred up bad blood to wage war.

She’s the villainess with a façade of a saintess.

“I love you. So just shut your mouth and die. Okay?”

But the moment her trusted lover chose her as a sacrifice to the demon, and she realized her father was behind the plan, she killed herself by swallowing poison. It hurt. It was so painful that she could not even scream. But it was fine. Because she knew this was not the end.

“I will save you this time.”

Then, she came back for her second life. She was determined to rescue those who were unlucky because of her and restored her life back.

“You do whatever you want for the man in your dream.” Demian said with a rough smile. 

“I’ll also protect you the way I want to.”

---
Laviore Rea Bailey, the fake saint and heartless puppet of the merciless Prince Sidar, drinks poison on the day the prince is to give her up as an offering to the devil. Instead of dying, she wakes up 10 years in the past. Set on righting her previous wrongs, Laviore vows to save the slave Damian Rhode Drake, whom she had once framed as a spy. As she gets closer to the mysterious Damian, new feelings start to emerge, but will this former villainess truly be able to change her ways?
description.fr:
Laviore Bailey, la «fausse sainte» qui a banni la princesse innocente et attisé le sang-froid pour faire la guerre.

«Je t'aime. Alors ferme ta bouche et meurs. D'accord?»

Mais au moment où son amant de confiance l'a choisie comme sacrifice au démon et qu'elle réalise que son père est derrière le plan, elle se suicide en avalant du poison.

Ça fait mal. C'est si douloureux qu'elle ne peut même pas crier. Mais c'est bien, car elle a échappée au sacrifice.

«Je vais vous sauver cette fois.»

Puis elle est revenue pour sa seconde vie. Elle est déterminée à sauver ceux qui n'ont pas eu de chance à cause d'elle.
description.id: Laviore Bailey—'Saintess palsu' yang mengusir putri tak berdosa dan mengobarkan darah buruk untuk berperang. Dia adalah penjahat dengan penampilan seperti saintess. "Aku mencintaimu. Jadi tutup saja mulutmu dan mati. Oke?" Tapi saat kekasihnya yang terpercaya memilihnya sebagai korban iblis, dan dia menyadari ayahnya berada di balik rencana tersebut, dia bunuh diri dengan menelan racun. Sakit. Sangat menyakitkan hingga dia bahkan tidak bisa berteriak. Tapi bukan masalah. Karena dia tahu ini bukanlah akhir. “Aku akan menyelamatkanmu kali ini.” Kemudian, dia kembali untuk kehidupan keduanya. Dia bertekad untuk menyelamatkan mereka yang tidak beruntung karenanya dan memulihkan hidupnya kembali. “Lakukan apapun yang kau inginkan untuk pria dalam mimpimu.” Ucap Demian sambil tersenyum kasar. “Aku juga akan melindungimu sesuai keinginanku.”
description.ko:
오트안의 가짜 성녀, '라비오르 리아 베일리'
연인의 배신으로 악마의 제물로 바쳐지는 것이 결정된 날,
모든 걸 되돌려 바로잡을 기회를 주겠다는 신의 목소리를 듣게 된다.

"뭐든지 할게요. 시간을 되돌릴 수 있다면…!"

찰나의 망설임도 없이 돌아온 두 번째 삶.

라라는 자신만의 방식으로 하나둘 이전 삶의 과오를 청산해나가지만
'데미안 로드 드레이크', 저로 인해 불행을 겪은 남자를
행복하게 해주겠다는 계획만은 도무지 뜻대로 풀리지 않는다.

"나 정도면 제법 자랑할 만한 노예 아닌가?
앞으로 6개월 동안 내 마스터 레이디가 되는 건 어때."

노예의 신분에서 자유롭게 해주겠다는 제안도 거절,

"제가 원하는 건 마스터 레이디께서 다 해주십니다.
그러니 포상은 제 마스터 레이디께만 해주십시오."

왕족의 포상을 받을 뻔했던 기회도 무산.

번번이 제 예상을 빗나가는 남자가
허를 찌르는 한 마디를 던진 순간,

"라라, 나는 성녀를 찾고있어."

라라의 운명은 또 한 번 움직이기 시작하는데…
description.uk:
Лавіора Бейлі - "фальшива свята," яка вигнала невинну принцесу і розпалила ворожнечу, щоб розв'язати війну.

Вона - лиходійка з обличчям святої.

"Я люблю тебе. Тож просто закрий рота і помри. Гаразд?"

Але в ту мить, коли її вірний коханий обрав її в жертву демону, і вона зрозуміла, що за цим планом стоїть її батько, вона вбила себе, проковтнувши отруту.

Це було боляче. Було так боляче, що вона не могла навіть крикнути. Але це було добре. Бо вона знала, що це не кінець.

"Цього разу я тебе врятую."

Потім вона повернулася до свого другого життя. Вона була сповнена рішучості рятувати тих, кому не пощастило через неї, і повернути своє життя назад.

"Роби все, що хочеш для чоловіка зі свого сну," - сказав Деміан з усмішкою на вустах.

"Я також буду захищати тебе так, як захочу."

description.de: Dohee, die ihr Leben lang von ihrem Umfeld ausgenutzt wurde, erwacht nach einem tödlichen Motorradunfall im Körper von Debora Shimore, der Antagonistin einer beliebten Reverse-Harem-Webnovel. Sie beschließt, sich nicht länger ausnutzen zu lassen und ihr neues Leben als Schurkin zu genießen. Sie muss nur sicherstellen, dass Debora nicht ihr vorbestimmtes Ende als Gefangene im Kloster findet. Dafür braucht sie, so glaubt sie anfangs, nur der Protagonistin und ihrem Harem aus dem Weg zu gehen, doch schon bald wird sie gezwungen, aktiver zu werden und sich mit dem Goldenen Drachen einzulassen.
description.en:
She possessed a villainess who is known and hated for her evil acts in an unpopular novel. But because of her personality, it was extremely difficult for her to play the villainess role. But not for long…

“I’ll fix your dress according to your taste this instant!”

“My request.”

“O-Of course! As per your request, there’s only one piece available in the whole Empire.”

People around me listen to me well even if I just frown and sit still. Since I don’t have to live in difficulty, I decided to just comfortably live on as a villainess.

“Father. Is it necessary for you to solve formulas in this slow and inefficient way?”

I thought it would be good to be a rich villainess, so I used all my knowledge.

“Why don’t you give me the honor of escorting the Princess?”

I have had enough of dealing with my father, so why did an unexpected character suddenly appear? What if this person disrupts my plan?

---
Dohee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. But it turns out that her new life is not without its perks, as Deborah Seymour is also the richest villain alive. Now, all that's left for her to do is lay low and enjoy her carefree lifestyle...if not for the fact that Deborah is fated to be sent to a monastery! Will this ex-doormat find a way to avoid yet another tragic ending, or will the challenges of being a villainess be too much for her?
description.fr:
Dohee a vécu comme une poule mouillée, a péri misérablement et a été réincarnée dans un roman en tant que vilaine notoire. Mais il s'avère que sa nouvelle vie n'est pas sans avantages, car Deborah Seymour est aussi la méchante la plus riche de l'Empire. Il ne lui reste plus qu'à faire profil bas et à profiter de son insouciance... Si ce n'est que Deborah est condamnée à être envoyée dans un monastère! Cette ancienne fainéante trouvera-t-elle un moyen d'éviter une nouvelle fin tragique, ou les défis d'une méchante seront-ils trop importants pour elle?

---
Debora Seymour est la pire vilaine jamais écrite: elle ne cesse de persécuter Mya, l’héroïne du roman, depuis qu’elle a appris que Pilaf Montes, l’homme dont elle est éprise, n’a d’yeux que pour elle. Mais quand Dohee, une étudiante en architecture, meurt et se réincarne dans sa peau, elle est bien contente d’être devenu quelqu’un qui ne se laisse pas marcher dessus. Elle va enfin pouvoir passer sa vie à se la couler douce!  Mais c’est sans compter une loi qui impose aux jeunes filles de famille noble à se marier à l’âge adulte. L’alternative est simple : acquérir un titre de noblesse. Mais par quel moyen? En l’achetant. Dohee va alors mettre au point un plan pour devenir riche.
description.hr:
Yoon Dohee, studentica arhitektonskog fakulteta, otkriva da ju njezine kolege i obitelj iskorištavaju za novac i kao besplatnu radnu snagu točno prije nego pogine u prometnoj nesreći.
Umjesto da zapravo umre ona se reinkarnira u ljubavni roman koji je nedavno čitala, ali ne kao glavni lik, nego kao glavni zlikovac i antagonist knjige Deborah Seymour.
Sada kao Deborah ona navigira novi život odmarajući se u bogatstu i raskoši, ali mora biti na oprezu jer je njezina reputacija duboko pod zemljom, a lik Debore u originalnoj knjizi završava svoju priču u tamnici.

description.ru:
Я переродилась в трагично-жестоком романе в ужасную злодейку, которую ненавидят, что бы она ни делала. Но разочарование было недолгим.

"Сейчас же сделайте платье по вкусу герцогини!"
"Чего-то вроде домашнего задания, разумеется, нет".
"Это единственный драгоценный камень в империи, который ты хотела".

Даже если я просто смирно сижу с недовольным выражением лица, окружающие люди ходят по струнке.
Разве есть необходимость быть тряпкой? Будет удобнее просто дальше жить как злодейка.

"Отец, обязательно ли решать пример таким медленным и неэффективным способом?"

Раз уж так вышло, я решила стать богатой злодейкой, поэтому воспользовалась всеми имеющимися знаниями.

"Как насчет того, чтобы оказать мне честь и позволить быть вашим эскортом?"

Мало было отца, мне еще неожиданно повезло с темной лошадкой, которой не было в планах.
description.uk:
Ду Хі опанувала тіло лиходійки одного непопулярного роману, яка була відома і ненависна всім за свої погані вчинки. Але через власний характер їй дуже важко правильно грати роль злодійки. Але ненадовго.. 

"Я зміню сукню згідно з вашим смаком негайно" 

"Моє прохання." 

"З-звісно! Згідно з вашим запитом, у всій імперії є лише одна річ." 

Люди навколо мене добре слухають, навіть якщо я просто хмурюсь і сиджу на місці. Оскільки мені не доводиться жити в труднощах, я вирішила просто комфортно жити у тілі лиходійки. 

«Батько, чи потрібно вам розв’язувати формули таким повільним і неефективним способом?» 

Я подумала, що було б добре бути багатою негідницею, тому використовувала усі свої знання. 

«Чому б вам не надати мені честь супроводжувати принцесу?» 

У мене досить багато справ з батьком, так чому раптом з’явився цей неочікуваний персонаж? Що, якщо ця людина спробує порушити мій план?

description.en:
In a world where gates suddenly appear and monsters emerge from them, hunter Yoon Min-jun lives burdened by guilt after losing his girlfriend, Jung Si-a, in a gate break incident.

One year after her death, on the anniversary of the tragedy, another disaster occurs at her grave… but this time, what emerges from the gate is not a monster.

It is Si-a herself.

The girlfriend he thought was dead has returned, but no longer as the person he once knew. She has become a dragon, the strongest living creature, and after spending an unimaginably long time searching for a way back to him, she now wants only one thing: to stay by Min-jun’s side… and make sure he did not find another girlfriend while she was gone.

description.en:
You know, sometimes you just gotta do what you gotta do to survive. Getting hit in the head with a liquor bottle? Yeah, no thanks. If booting my deadbeat dad to the curb is what it takes, then so be it. Who cares about being the 'good' daughter when your skull's not intact?

And honestly, this whole 'rebuilding the family and getting back home' plan? It started with a bit of divine intervention, or so they say about that land. Next thing I know, bam! I became Countess Validus, blessed by the gods and apparently a real estate mogul.

Then the "just trying to make my life easier" snowball started. A little business here, a tiny push towards the Magic Tower there (hey, free research!), pointing out a few flaws in some laws (someone had to!), maybe tossing a sponsorship bone or two (art can be an investment, right?), and... why not, a school? Knowledge is power, and all that jazz.

The thing is, I wasn't exactly expecting a fan club to spring up. My staff acts like I hung the moon. Then this one lord suddenly wants to be my shadow, apparently my word is gospel now, and someone even called me the hope of the nation! And the proposals? Don't even get me started. All I did was try to not get hit in the head again and maybe, just maybe, find a way back to my own couch. Why is everyone acting like I'm some kind of saint? It's beyond me.

후레자식이 되더라도 일단은 살아야 할 것 아닌가?

그렇게 자연히 원작을 건드려

“사업을 한번 해 볼까 하는데….”
“마탑에 들어가고 싶어요?”
“이 법안은 문제가 너무 많아요!”
“후원 한번 받아 볼래?”
“학교를 한번 세워 볼까?”

양심의 가책도 없이 계속 건드렸더니...
 
“아가씨! 아니, 주인님!”
“세라, 당신의 부하가 되겠어요.”
“세라가 하는 말이면 당연히 믿어야죠.”
“백작은 이 나라의 희망이야.”
“저를 받아주시겠습니까.”

그냥 저 편하려고 돈 벌고 명예를 쌓아 가는 것뿐인데
왜들 이렇게 몰려와서 떠받들고 충성 맹세하고 난리인지,

description.en:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!
____
"The stupid youngest one, the one who doesn't know how to do anything, but causes trouble with her cute face."

Exasperated, I looked in the mirror once again and exclaimed, "Why am I the 'stupid youngest one' Diana Cartier!"

In the novel *The Ending Can't Be the Destruction of the World*, Diana is an evil woman who repeatedly commits evil deeds and is brainwashed by the villain, contributing greatly to the destruction of the world! If something could go wrong for the villainess, it will. But when something went wrong for me, I recalled my past life instead? As an ordinary college student in my past life, I made up my mind when I realized that I had been reincarnated as Diana Cartier, the villainess in the novel.

"The world is going to end. But I'm not going to let it happen."

Yes, I will prevent the end of the world with my own hands! And save my brothers from the conspiracy at the same time! Wait a minute. What's that pitch black thing sprawled out on the floor over there? Wait. That face, where have I seen it before? 

'Is that Linus del Stein?!'

Why are you lying there, Mr. Protagonist of the novel who will destroy this world?

Diana and her brothers are trying their best to stop the end of the world! And cute animals and other stuff? Our sweet youngest is preventing the end of the world, get out of the way!
description.fr:
«La plus jeune et sotte, celle qui ne sait rien faire, mais qui cause des ennuis avec son joli minois.»

Exaspérée, je me suis à nouveau regardée dans le miroir et je me suis exclamée, «Pourquoi suis-je la 'plus jeune stupide' Diana Cartier!»

Dans le roman *Le fin ne peut pas la destruction du monde*, Diana est une femme maléfique qui commet des actes néfastes à répétition et subit un lavage de cerveau de la part du méchant, ce qui contribue grandement à la destruction du monde! Si quelque chose peut mal tourner pour la méchante, cela se produira. Mais quand quelque chose tourne mal pour moi, je me souviens plutôt de ma vie passée? J'étais une étudiante ordinaire dans ma vie passée, et j'ai pris ma décision lorsque j'ai réalisé que j'avais été réincarnée en Diana Cartier, la méchante du roman.

«Le monde va s'écrouler. Mais je ne vais pas laisser faire.»

Oui, je vais empêcher la fin du monde de mes propres mains! Et sauver mes frères de la conspiration en même temps! Attendez un peu. Qu'est-ce que c'est que cette chose noire sur le sol là-bas? Attendez. Ce visage, où l'ai-je déjà vu?

‹Est-ce Linus del Stein?!›

Pourquoi êtes-vous allongé là, Monsieur le Protagoniste du roman qui va détruire ce monde?

Diana et ses frères font de leur mieux pour empêcher la fin du monde! Et des animaux mignons et d'autres choses? Notre adorable petit dernier est en train d'empêcher la fin du monde, pousse-toi de là!

description.en: Jenesia, a brilliant sorcerer, was murdered after witnessing an affair between her fiancé and her best friend. With her final breath, Jenesia managed to use her magical powers to turn back time. Reliving her past, will Jenesia finally be able to find happiness?
description.fr: Yennesia était la plus jeune sorcière de la cour et la fille illégitime de Lambrice et avait un fiancé bien-aimé, le 4e prince Havaer Randy Hillon. Cependant, après que les recherches magiques qu'elle avait commencées pour son fiancé se soient soldées par un échec, sa vie fut bouleversée. Dès qu'elle est tombée en phase terminale, le fiancé en qui elle avait confiance l'a abandonnée... L'homme qu'elle aimait la trompait avec sa meilleure amie. La dernière décision de Yennesia fut d'utiliser sa magie afin de remonter le temps.
description.ko:
최연소 궁정 마법사이자 램브리체 가문의 사생아였던 예네시아.
사랑하는 약혼자의 부탁으로 시작했던 '시간 역행 마법 연구'가 
계속해서 실패하자 연구의 부작용으로 병까지 얻게 되었다.

심지어 사랑했던 약혼자가 자신의 절친과 바람을 피우는 것을 목격하고, 살해당한다. 

"고마워 예네시아. 이건 친구가 주는 마지막 선물이라고 생각할게."

예네시아는 끊어지는 숨을 겨우 붙잡으며 
마지막으로 '시간 역행 마법'을 시도해 보기로 하는데..!
